- When sentiment is strongly positive (≥ 0.67) over recent days, model tends to overestimate prices; reduce forecast by 1–3% for next 5–10 days.  
- After a sharp price spike (forecast > 75% of recent high), model often overshoots; cap forecast at +5% above recent peak for 3–7 days.  
- If sentiment is consistently negative (≤ -0.33) and price is falling, model underestimates; add 1–2% to forecast for next 5–10 days.  
- Model frequently overreacts to sentiment shifts; if sentiment flips from + to - within 3 days, adjust forecast downward by 2–5% for next 7 days.  
- Mean reversion is strong in 30-day horizon; if forecast is > 20% above 30-day moving average, reduce by 1–3% per day for 5–10 days.  
- If sentiment is neutral (0.00–0.33) and price is trending, model often misses mean reversion; forecast should be adjusted to 1–2% below recent 18-day average.
